title: Anti-Leaf Litter
description: Edits the leaf litter loot table to act like tall grass. You can now only get it with shears.
body: Edits the leaf litter loot tables to mimic that of tall grass. You want it? Use shears. You will no longer have leaf litter clogging up your inventory for all eternity. And no more finding it scattered all over the place at the end of water falls! If you hate leaf litter as much as I do, here you go!
